info.title: SBA Loan Origination API
info.description:
The Loan Origination API supports the Lending Experience used by lenders and lender service providers to prepare, review, and submit SBA loan applications.

The API exposes loan applications and the supporting information attached to them: project details, agents and agent services, associated users, terms periods, uses of proceeds, collateral, businesses and individuals, ownership relationships, sources and uses, documents, tasks and comments, compliance screening results, and validation results.

## Conventions

* All request and response bodies use JSON unless a media type is stated on the operation. Document uploads use `multipart/form-data`.
* Collection endpoints return a page object containing `count`, `next`, `previous`, and `results`. Use `limit` and `offset` to move through the pages.
* Money amounts are returned as decimal values with at most two decimal places.
* Timestamps are returned in ISO 8601 format using UTC.
* Fields marked read-only are set by the service and are ignored if supplied in a request.

## Authentication

Requests are authenticated with the session cookie issued when a user signs in to the Lending Experience application. Requests that create, change, or delete data must also send the matching cross-site request forgery token in the `X-CSRFToken` header. Requests without a valid session receive `401`; requests from a user who is not permitted to act on the requested record receive `403`.

## Example values

All examples in this document are fictional and are provided for illustration only.

post.description:
Creates a collateral asset for a lending application.

Use this operation once for each collateral asset. After the asset is
created, use the returned identifier to create any related titled
assets, lienholders, and pledger associations.

This operation is part of loan-workflow step 7:
Collateral Detail.

Adds identifying and ownership information for a titled collateral
asset, such as a vehicle, vessel, aircraft, or other titled property.

The requested workflow refers to this operation as
`POST /titled-assets/`. The documented API path is
`/collateral-titled-assets/`.

Use the collateral asset identifier returned by
`POST /collateral-assets/`.

This operation is part of loan-workflow step 7:
Collateral Detail.

Adds a prior lienholder and lien position to a collateral asset.

Use the collateral asset identifier returned by
`POST /collateral-assets/`.

This operation is part of loan-workflow step 7:
Collateral Detail.

post.summary: Associate a person or business with collateral
post.description:
Creates an association between collateral and the person or business
pledging that collateral.

Provide exactly one of `loan_app_company_id` or
`loan_app_person_id`.

The pledging person or business must belong to the same lending
application as the collateral asset.

This operation is part of loan-workflow step 7:
Collateral Detail.

get.description:
Returns a paginated collection of current company profiles.
Use `q` to search company names or tax identifiers. Use `tax_id` to filter by tax identifier. Results may be ordered using the `ordering` parameter, and optional related information may be requested with `optional_fields`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search text matched against the company name or tax identifier.

parameters.name: tax_id
parameters.description: Tax identifier used to filter company profiles.

200.description: A paginated collection of company profiles.

post.description:
Creates a new current company profile.
A company name is required. Existing business and mailing addresses may be associated with the company by supplying their numeric identifiers. The website must be a valid reachable URL, and the tax identifier must be valid for the selected tax identifier type.

201.description: The company profile was created successfully.

get.description: Returns one current company profile identified by its numeric resource identifier.

put.description: Updates a company profile and returns the resulting company information. Fields supplied in the request are validated before the profile is saved.

200.description: The company profile was updated successfully.

patch.description: Updates only the company profile fields included in the request and returns the updated company information.

200.description: The company profile was updated successfully.

post.description:
Creates a point-in-time company record for historical reference, reporting, audit, or business continuity purposes.
The optional `cloned_from_id` field may identify the current company profile from which the snapshot originated.

201.description: The company snapshot was created successfully.

get.description: Returns one historical company snapshot identified by its numeric resource identifier.

Returns a paginated collection of people associated with companies.
Use `company_id` to retrieve employees associated with a specific company. Use `name` to search employees by full name. Results may be ordered and paginated.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Numeric identifier of the company whose employees should be returned.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search text matched against the employee's full name.

200.description: A paginated collection of company employees.

post.summary: Add an employee to a company
post.description:
Creates an employee profile and associates it with the company identified by `company_id`.
The company association is required when creating the employee and cannot be changed after creation.

201.description: The employee profile was created successfully.

get.description: Returns one company employee profile identified by its numeric resource identifier.

put.description: Updates an employee profile and returns the resulting employee information. The employee's company association cannot be changed.

200.description: The employee profile was updated successfully.

patch.description: Updates only the employee profile fields included in the request. The employee's company association cannot be changed.

200.description: The employee profile was updated successfully.

post.description:
Creates a point-in-time employee record for historical reference, reporting, audit, or business continuity purposes.
The optional `cloned_from_id` field may identify the current employee profile from which the snapshot originated.

201.description: The employee snapshot was created successfully.

get.description: Returns one historical employee snapshot identified by its numeric resource identifier.

Returns document requirements that the authenticated user is
authorized to view.

Supply `loan_app_id` to retrieve documents for a specific loan
application. Use `limit` and `offset` for pagination.

Use this operation to determine which documents are still needed
before validation or submission.

200.description: A page of loan-application document requirements.

post.description:
Uploads a PDF file and associates it with an existing loan-application
document requirement.

The file must use the `application/pdf` media type and must not exceed
50 MiB. The file may remain unavailable for download while security
scanning is in progress.

Use the document requirement identifier returned by
`GET /loan-app-docs/`.

get.description:
Downloads the PDF associated with an uploaded document file.

The file is available only after the required security scan has
completed successfully. If scanning is still in progress, the file
may not yet be available for download.

Content-Disposition.description: Suggested filename for the downloaded document.

404.description:
The file was not found or is not yet available because security
scanning has not completed.

post.description:
Checks whether a file meets the document-upload requirements without
saving it.

The file must be a PDF no larger than 50 MiB. A successful response
confirms that the file passed the documented pre-upload validation.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of active issues associated with loan applications that the signed-in user is authorized to view. Results can be filtered to a specific loan application. Lender-facing users see only requests that have been sent to the lender.

200.description: A paginated list of loan application issues.

post.summary: Mark a lender request as addressed
post.description: Marks a lender request as addressed. This action is available only when the request has been sent to the lender, has not been resolved by the center, and is not already marked as addressed. A successful response has no response body.

200.description: The request was marked as addressed. No response body is returned.

post.summary: Mark a lender request as unaddressed
post.description: Marks a lender request as unaddressed. This action is available only when the request has been sent to the lender, has not been resolved by the center, and is currently marked as addressed. A successful response has no response body.

200.description: The request was marked as unaddressed. No response body is returned.

post.summary: Add a business to a lending application
post.description: Adds a business to a loan application as a party to the application, and returns the stored record with the identifier assigned to it.

post.summary: Add an individual to a lending application
post.description: Adds an individual to a loan application as a party to the application, and returns the stored record with the identifier assigned to it.

post.summary: Record an individual's ownership of a business
post.description: Records the ownership interest an individual holds in a business at the point the loan application is prepared.

post.summary: Record ownership of one business by another
post.description: Records the ownership interest one business holds in another at the point the loan application is prepared.

post.summary: Create or update a business eligibility assessment

200.description: Business eligibility assessment created or updated.

post.description: Records the eligibility answers for a business on a loan application. Submitting the same business again replaces the answers already recorded for it.

get.description: Returns the complete collection of agents available to the authenticated caller. Each result includes the agent identifier, display name, address information when available, and contact-person information when available. This read-only operation does not accept a request body.

200.description: The agent collection was retrieved successfully.

get.description: Returns the complete collection of countries available as reference data. Each result contains a stable country identifier, a short country code, and a human-readable country name. This read-only operation does not accept a request body.

200.description: The country collection was retrieved successfully.

get.description: Returns the complete collection of franchise reference values. Each result includes a stable identifier, franchise code, and display name. This read-only operation does not accept a request body.

200.description: The franchise collection was retrieved successfully.

get.description: Returns index source rate records available to the authenticated caller. Results include the source name, effective start date and time, optional end date and time, and applicable percentage rate. Use the optional `index_sources` query parameter to request one or more supported sources. Multiple values are supplied as a comma-separated string.

200.description: The requested index source rate collection was retrieved successfully.

get.summary: Retrieve all available NAICS industry codes
get.description: Returns the complete collection of NAICS industry classification codes available as reference data. Each result includes the classification code, industry name, maximum eligible dollar amount when defined, and maximum eligible employee count when defined. This read-only operation does not accept a request body.

200.description: The NAICS code collection was retrieved successfully.

post.summary: Create an applicant equity injection source
post.description: Adds an applicant equity injection source to an editable loan application.

201.description: Applicant equity injection source created successfully.

post.description: Adds financing from a source other than the requested loan or applicant equity.

post.summary: Create a planned use of loan proceeds
post.description: Adds a planned use to an editable loan application. Required fields may depend on the selected use type.

post.summary: Associate an address with a planned use
post.description: Associates an existing address with a planned use of loan proceeds.

get.description: Returns the latest available compliance screening result for each business or individual and screening source associated with the requested loan application. Without a loan application filter, returns all compliance checks available to the authenticated user.

200.description: A paginated collection of compliance screening results.

get.description: Returns compliance alerts associated with loan applications available to the authenticated user. Use the loan application filter to retrieve alerts for a specific application. Results include the screening source, alert reason, affected party information, current screening status, and resolution flags.

200.description: A paginated collection of compliance alerts.

patch.summary: Update the status of a compliance alert
patch.description: Updates the resolution status of a compliance alert. Set is_resolved to true after the alert has been addressed. Set is_declined to true when the alert is declined; a declined alert remains unresolved. Only the status fields are intended for updates. Some users may be restricted to changing only the resolution status, and an alert cannot be resolved if it is already declined or otherwise not eligible for resolution.

post.summary: Run validations for a parent object
post.description: Runs the validation rules for the supplied parent record. When `changed` is omitted or empty, every applicable rule is run. When `changed` contains field paths, only the results for those fields are cleared before the rules are run. The response reports the validation results that apply after the run.

400.description: A required request property is missing.

404.description: The parent object was not found or is not accessible.

put.summary: Replace a validation failure's writable state
put.description: Replaces the changeable values of a validation result. Only the dismissal timestamp can be set; the identifier and the parent record cannot be changed.

patch.description: Updates the dismissal timestamp of a validation result. Send `dismissed_at` with a timestamp to dismiss the result, or `null` to restore it.

get.description: Returns the fields that currently have visible validation results for the requested parent record. `parent_object_id` and `parent_object_model` are both required. When the signed-in user is not permitted to see the parent record, an empty page is returned rather than an error.

400.description: A required query parameter is missing.
